steps: Obtain the application form from the District Sainik Welfare Officer or download it from the official website.
Fill in all mandatory fields in the application form and attach copies of mandatory documents.
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with documents to the District Sainik Welfare Officer.
Request a receipt or acknowledgment of submission containing details like date, time, and identification number.
parsed.department: Department of Sainik Welfare, Government of Rajasthan
